caption: The drawing depicts a single, old-fashioned coffee grinder positioned in the center of a plain, light-beige or off-white background. The grinder is made predominantly of brown wood, with a square, slightly rounded base and a bulbous midsection tapering upward. Attached to the top is a metal crank handle, colored in a dark gray and brownish hue, with a knob at the end that is wooden and similar in tone to the rest of the grinder. The crank is positioned horizontally, extending out to the right side of the drawing. The object is rendered with visible shading and highlights to indicate the three-dimensional form and the surface texture of the wooden material. Below and to the right of the grinder, there is a small block of printed or drawn text on the background. There are no other objects or additional details in the composition.
title: Coffee Grinder
